Go beneath the waves into the ultimate predator’s paradise: the ocean. In this full episode of World's Deadliest from Nat Geo Animals, discover how marine hunters use deadly precision, camouflage, and lethal weaponry to survive and thrive in the deep sea. From coastal reef assassins to goliaths of the deep, explore the extraordinary survival adaptations of the world's most feared marine life. In these ocean battlegrounds, one mistake means a one-way ticket to Davy Jones’ locker.
